generationRuns.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 1024×1536 portrait master artwork for a layered interactive tarot holographic card, The Sun, theme title “云上晴城”.
Primary request: exactly one joyful, clearly age-appropriate child fully clothed in a pale saffron riding coat, seated safely on exactly one complete white horse. The child smiles with both arms open. Place horse and child in the lower-right, looking to the right; all four hooves visibly grounded on a broad, solid, physical floating garden platform with substantial side thickness and a continuous landscaped top. The platform begins beneath every hoof and extends toward the left-upper distance into a bright cloud city of terraces and sunflower gardens. Include believable saddle, bridle, reins, rider contact and hoof shadows. One huge golden sun is centered high with margin.
Scene: luminous aerial garden city, sky cyan, cream-white cloud layers, golden sun, sunflower terraces. No ocean, snow, greenhouse, field furrows, or precarious thin floating slab.
Style: premium richly detailed painterly fantasy tarot art, crisp readable anatomy/materials, original composition.
Composition: vertical 2:3. The garden platform needs a full visible outer edge and depth, not a narrow strip. Leave 5% safety margin around face, hands and horse ears.
Lighting/palette: azure, cream white, gold; do not metallicize skin.
Constraints: exactly one clothed child, one white horse and one sun; no duplicate limbs/faces/animals/suns; no cropped/translucent horse, no floating platform without thickness, no exposed torso, text, border, watermark, checkerboard or baked holographic effects.

Create a graphic production mask, NOT an artistic scene. Exact 1024×1536 canvas. Retain the complete connected foreground at its current coordinates: clothed child, white horse, mane/hair, saddle, bridle/reins, riding contact, all four hooves, hoof shadows, and the complete solid foreground garden platform including its top and thick visible outer side/rim below every hoof. Replace every other pixel with exactly one uniform flat neon green #00FF00 (RGB 0,255,0). Every background pixel must be that exact green; no sky, city, sun, cloud, gradient, black, glow, texture, checkerboard, text, frame or transparency. Do not crop, reposition, redraw or change the foreground. This is solely for deterministic chroma keying.
generationRuns.conclusion: accepted as same-canvas deterministic green-key source

generationRuns.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: opaque 1024×1536 background layer for a Sun tarot holographic card, theme 云上晴城.
Input images: first image is the finished vertical master artwork whose composition, visual style, light, city, sun, clouds and palette must be preserved; second image is the same-coordinate chroma-green foreground mask showing the exact foreground group to remove.
Primary request: remove only the complete foreground group shown against green: child, white horse, saddle, bridle, reins, all four hooves, and the entire near floating garden platform including its thickness, flowers, railings and waterfalls. Fill every removed region naturally as the distant continuation of the master’s luminous cloud-city: azure sky, cream cloud layers, airborne sunflower terraces, distant garden palaces and bridges. Retain the huge central golden sun and existing distant city architecture. The result must look like one continuous atmospheric background with convincing depth behind where the foreground platform sat.
Constraints: output a fully opaque RGB painting. No child, no horse, no saddle, no bridle, no reins, no hooves, no foreground platform, no close-up flowers, no empty holes, no duplicate subject silhouettes, no green, transparency, checkerboard, text, border, watermark or baked holographic effect. Keep vertical 2:3 composition and premium detailed painterly fantasy tarot style.
